desc: Fuel your adrenaline with this relentless, thrilling and riveting LATIN MUSIC compilation built for ACTION SPORTS. This record features regionally marked Latin breakbeats from an extensive OCHO study of folkloric Latin rhythms adapted to drum-set.

tracks.desc: ¡¡ Adrenalina pura !! Meticulously engineered for relentless forward momentum and action-packed sports highlights, this LATIN ROCK inspired up-tempo track provides the explosive fuel editors need to push the visuals harder, faster, and higher. Features up-front, slamming drums and electric guitar leads along this a driving, pulsing bass line. A pounding, cumbia inspired and sped up piano part supports the intensity. Pure adrenaline. Regional marking = MEXICO.

Rising and climbing with driving intensity, this fun, up-tempo track featuring a heavy SAMBA beat and accompanying Brazilian percussion delivers an ear-wormy crowd chant: "SOY EL CAMPEÖN"( I am the champion). Track highlights includes folkloric percussion and "apitos de samba" (samba whistles) that cut through the drum ensemble. A phasey, electric guitar lead lends a Latin rock feel. Regional marking = BRAZIL.

This aggressive, CUMBIA ROCK inspired mid-tempo track begins by creating heavy metal tension with hard--hitting drums that release by shifting to a syncopated CUMBIA beat with cowbell accents. Supporting percussion, droning basslines, twisting guitar leads, distorted synths and rumbling floor toms add to the rising action that steps up with each section of the track. Ideal for BASEBALL, BASKETBALL, BOXING, SOCCER and EXTREME SPORTS. Regional marking = COLOMBIA.

Capturing the raw intersection of Puerto Rican folkloric rhythms and extreme athletics, this heart pounding LATIN ROCK track features up-front drums delivering the island's BOMBA SICÁ beat alongside a forceful, pick-driven bassline, shredding electric guitar leads and a crowd chanting "To Victory" (thus the track title "A ganar"). Ideal for BASEBALL, BASKETBALL, BOXING, SOCCER and EXTREME SPORTS. Regional marking = PUERTO RICO.

Playful rapid-fire track inspired by Argentinian LATIN ROCK from the 1970's and 80's delivering an electrifying, sweat-drenched musical experience that refuses to slow down. Highlights include harmonized electric guitar leads, a classic arena rock style synths and a call + response section with ginormous crowd hand claps. Ideal for BASEBALL, BASKETBALL, BOXING, SOCCER and EXTREME SPORTS. Regional marking = ARGENTINA.

Influenced by Mexican Stadium Rock, where classic accordion runs are played by a Hammond organ with arena drenched reverb, this sonic assault pays homage to deep purple inspired vibes. Highlights of this LATIN ROCK track also include a blistering synth topline and a crowd chanting "CAMPEONES" (champions) suitable for a black sabbath. Ideal for BASEBALL, BASKETBALL, BOXING, SOCCER and EXTREME SPORTS. Regional marking = MEXICO.

Imagine a a red baron airplane flying a banner with the words "ADELANTE" (keep moving forward) !! Commanding you to move and react, this arena homage to LATIN METAL and Spanish Hard Rock features up-front drums accompanied by aggressive guitar and bass hooks playing in unison plus special effects. Ideal for BASEBALL, BASKETBALL, BOXING, SOCCER and EXTREME SPORTS. Regional marking = SPAIN.

A fusion of Heavy Metal and BACHATA ROCK, this track is specifically designed for either player walkups or an ending credits highlight reel. The chorus features a syncopated beat adapted to drumset from folkloric instruments on traditional bachata recordings. A cool synth part also elevates the chorus and contrasts against the hard-hitting percussion stabs. Ideal for BASEBALL, BASKETBALL, BOXING, SOCCER and EXTREME SPORTS. Regional marking = DOMINICAN REPUBLIC.
